title: MpiWindowedSampler: temporal windowing so the H3 2K refine reaches 124 frames
description: Stage-2 refine OOMs at 2K above T=27 latent frames, but H3 TRAINED_MIN is 124 frames (T=37). A windowed drop-in for SamplerCustomAdvanced samples overlapping temporal windows and crossfades them, so the refine runs at a window size already proven to fit. Serves ltx_video_upscale.json on the same code path. Node lives in the sibling repo ComfyUi-MpiNodes.
